architecture.messages: WeChat private ClawBot <-> Tencent iLink <-> standalone plugin component <-> existing native DSH Session
architecture.plugin: Owns provider credentials, polling, durable bounded inbox/outbox and exactly selected local profile session; default paused.
architecture.mini: Optional remote controls over the existing authenticated LAN/E2EE gateway. Local opt-in defaults off. Closing that switch hides management, sidebar markers and routing menu; it never stops the bot.
architecture.cloud: No new message transport, bot credentials or history storage. Existing opaque E2EE control relay may be used.
architecture.native: Uses registered session/list and session/prompt plus native observation. Does not register model tools, edit presets/defaults, start services or manage host processes.
architecture.authorization: Native approvals and scopes remain unchanged. ClawBot does not mint mini owner-input proofs or auto-approve tools/private publication. Pairing must be confirmed in WeChat by the trusted intended operator.
architecture.scope: One bot and one active ordinary existing session per native profile. Desktop/Web are separate nodes. No cross-node credential transfer or distributed handoff. Cold sessions and forks retain native admission checks.

bindingLifecycle.behavior: Request official QR payload. Confirm in WeChat; optional same-phone native image preview and copied official link are test paths, not proof of authorization.
Resume saved token directly; no new QR. A successful provider poll, not a stored token alone, establishes live connectivity.
Pause on provider -14. Reconfirm while retaining unfinished receipts; same user/account retains cursor and pending work without replay.
Supply only this profile's own existing token in local_token_list; retain credentials when official response says already bound. Without local credentials, do not invent pairing success.

Do not import another node's tokens or claim takeover is automatic. Request explicit official confirmation and warn to check WeChat's existing-binding prompt; provider effects require real-account acceptance.
Refuse replacing an existing local user. Explicit local disconnect is required first; old replies never move to the new identity.

Paused only, expectedRevision required, explicit abandonPending confirmation. Seal unfinished receipts, erase content/context and keep bounded dedupe metadata. In-flight native tasks continue in DSH; late results cannot revive sealed deliveries. This is not Tencent-side revocation.

noCameraResearch.payload: Tencent already returns qrcode_img_content. No encode-then-decode step is necessary; qrcode is separately used for confirmation polling.
noCameraResearch.directOpen: No documented mini API was found that accepts an arbitrary decoded QR payload and invokes ClawBot's native confirmation route. wx.scanCode returns result/rawData, not accepting them as inputs. No verified ClawBot appId/path/shortLink is published in the inspected sources.
noCameraResearch.implementedCandidate: wx.previewImage with showmenu:true, plugin-rendered QR written to private temporary mini storage; bounded cleanup on return, exit and timeout. Copied official pairing URL is also exposed. Neither action is treated as successful pairing.

deviceEvidence.source: User-performed device test with screenshots at 14:22 and explicit follow-up that Continue connecting was not pressed; exact WeChat client version was not supplied.
deviceEvidence.route: Copy the current pairing URL into the user's own File Transfer Assistant chat and tap the link; no camera scan or image recognition.
deviceEvidence.observed: The WeChat confirmation page opened and warned that continuing would disconnect an existing OpenClaw connection.
deviceEvidence.conclusion: Direct HTTPS link activation from this user's WeChat chat can reach the official confirmation page without QR recognition. Binding completion, replacement effects, and direct launch from our mini-program remain unverified.
deviceEvidence.safety: No confirmation, replacement or disconnect was performed by the assistant. The user explicitly stopped before Continue connecting. Pairing URLs, QR values and account identifiers are not stored in this record.

miniLaunchResearch.status: No verified ClawBot-specific public mini-program launch contract found; successful chat-link routing is not evidence of mini-program launch permission.
miniLaunchResearch.businessView: Official wx.openBusinessView documentation examined here applies to enterprise payments, requires product/API access and provider-issued businessType/queryString. It does not establish a generic LiteApp or ClawBot entry; do not guess or reuse payment parameters.

noCameraResearch.notClaimed: No silent first-time authorization, account takeover, arbitrary private scheme or guaranteed same-phone recognition.

localLimitsNotProviderGuarantees.recovery: Atomic batch+cursor; fixed request/message IDs. Interrupted native dispatch or ambiguous provider send is not automatically retried. Exact-once outside the retained dedupe window is not promised.

passed.pluginExistingSuite: npm test exit 0; environment-specific skips in existing tests remain skips, not device acceptance
passed.miniVisual: 32 source-derived layout captures at 320/390 CSS pixels in light/dark themes; not WeChat device rendering
passed.packedCore: 316 module checks, 25 host entries and 88 strict schema equivalence checks; isolated actual tarball verification
passed.packedInstaller: 326 exact core files verified in the dual-entry installer; native metadata, dependencies and offline CLI checks passed

verification.automated: Protocol, runtime lifecycle, actual TSX controller, native DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 strict schema/controller and mini-to-native RPC tests; synthetic accounts only.
verification.nativeBoundary: Offline native component mount/dispose/remount does not change native tools, presets, defaults or the four shipped mode YAML files. No network/model calls in that test.
limitations: Installed native prompt lacks an atomic generation precondition. The adapter rejects observed resets and refuses mismatched replies, but cannot seal a reset inside the host's own asynchronous admission path. Pause ClawBot before resetting its target during initial acceptance.

User-performed same-phone chat-link routing reached the official replacement-confirmation page on 2026-10-08, without pressing Continue connecting. Completed real-account login, mini-program direct launch, long-press routing, actual provider rebind effects, real text exchange and broader physical mobile rendering remain unverified.
A native approval or question hands control back to desktop/mini. The first candidate does not resume watching that detached turn or approve it via ClawBot.
No real installation, mini upload, cloud deployment, GitHub publication or host restart is part of this candidate build.
